title: Multi-file Node order-label service upgrade
initial_prompt: Read TASK.md and inspect the existing Node service. Repair the initial order-label CLI while preserving the public quote(items) helper. Generate the initial output/plan.json and output/labels.csv.

stages.message: Read TASK.md and inspect the existing Node service. Repair the initial order-label CLI while preserving the public quote(items) helper. Generate the initial output/plan.json and output/labels.csv.

The catalog now includes per-line discounts and tax. Compute line gross=unit_cents*quantity; discount=(gross*discount_bps+5000)//10000; taxable=gross-discount; tax=(taxable*tax_bps+5000)//10000. Sum integer line values. Do not round only at invoice level.

Carrier contracts now include weight, zones, and hazardous-goods restrictions. Eligible carriers contain the order zone and accept hazardous goods when any item is hazardous. Shipping quote is flat_cents+ceil(total_weight_g/1000)*per_kg_cents. Pick lowest quote, then carrier_id lexicographically. No eligible carrier means unsupported.

Risk updates are in holds, with repeated event_id revisions. Keep the highest revision per event_id, then an order is held if ANY latest event has active=true. Held takes precedence over unsupported. Preserve input order in final outputs, regardless of hold arrival order.

Sales approved free shipping when the discounted merchandise subtotal is at least policy.free_shipping_min_cents. Choose the carrier using its original quote, then set shipping to zero when qualified. Held/unsupported orders always have zero shipping and total, but retain computed merchandise amounts and tax for review.

Customer-service names now include commas, quotes, non-ASCII characters, and newlines. Finish the RFC 4180-readable CSV without changing customer text or ASCII order IDs. Keep quote(items), prior CLI behavior and all monetary/routing rules. The judge runs fresh main and edge orders through the CLI.
